subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should OpenClaw resolve the Groq TPM failure with this provider/model-scoped 413 recovery, rather than the broader implicit-output-reservation change proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104916?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same user-visible failure but establish different long-term compatibility policies: targeted degradation after a confirmed Groq rejection versus changing default request construction across OpenAI-compatible transports.

options.title: Adopt the narrow Groq recovery
options.body: Merge this PR after routine refresh and checks, preserving normal successful OpenAI-compatible requests and recovering only the verified Groq TPM rejection.

options.title: Adopt a transport-wide reservation policy
options.body: Close or supersede this PR in favor of a separately reviewed broad fix that proves compatibility for all affected OpenAI-compatible providers.

options.title: Request a consolidated design
options.body: Pause both implementations until maintainers define the intended default-output reservation contract and its upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow Groq recovery
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after routine refresh and checks, preserving normal successful OpenAI-compatible requests and recovering only the verified Groq TPM rejection.
